title: Total derived strict inverse limit and principal Koszul completion
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, small or essentially small relative to a chosen module universe, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use derived categories $D(\mathcal A)$ and $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A))$ with localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], where $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\mathcal A)$ is the category of strict inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system]. Define $\operatorname{koszulRlim}_{\mathcal O}:D(\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A))\to D(\mathcal A)$ to be the total right derived inverse-limit functor supplied, together with its universal right-derived comparison, by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. This is the functor in the chosen right-derived pair; it is determined together with its comparison up to the unique compatible natural isomorphism. For every cochain complex $P$ of $\mathcal O$-modules and global section $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$, let $V_n=[\mathcal O\xrightarrow{t^{n+1}}\mathcal O]\otimes_{\mathcal O}P$ with its canonical strict transitions, and let $X(V)$ be its degreewise presentation as a cochain complex in $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)$, both as in [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers]. Define $\operatorname{koszulCompletion}_{\mathcal O}(P,t)=\operatorname{koszulRlim}_{\mathcal O}(Q(X(V)))$. Neither regularity of $t$, K-flatness of $P$, boundedness nor exactness of countable products is required for these definitions.
